response.justification: The candidate has strong technical depth, open-source contributions, and diverse experience across stacks and domains, but lacks demonstrated leadership in IT architecture, UML modeling, and team management at an executive level, and has only basic German proficiency — a hard requirement.
strengths: Extensive open-source contributions with real-world impact (GISCollective)
Proven full-stack expertise across languages, platforms, and architectures
Strong track record in mentoring, workshops, and community knowledge-sharing
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, not meeting C1 requirement
No clear evidence of UML expertise or formal architecture design leadership
Lacks documented experience managing teams or leading client-facing technical strategy
